title: Farmslot recipe protocol documentation and onboarding smoke
description: Validates protocol examples, self-validation fixtures, and onboarding commands with the shared v1 contract validator.

validate-backend-example.cmd: cd apps/command-center && yarn farmslot recipe validate ../../../docs/examples/recipes/backend-command-v1.recipe.json
validate-backend-example.intent: Validate the backend/API sample recipe with the shared Farmslot v1 contract validator.

validate-ui-example.cmd: cd apps/command-center && yarn farmslot recipe validate ../../../docs/examples/recipes/ui-live-v1.recipe.json
validate-ui-example.intent: Validate the UI live replay sample recipe with the shared Farmslot v1 contract validator.

validate-self-fixtures.cmd: cd apps/command-center && yarn test:protocol && yarn test:recipe-harness
validate-self-fixtures.intent: Validate every Farmslot self-validation recipe package and ensure it emits summary, trace, manifest, and resolved recipe artifacts.

index-artifacts.intent: Publish validator report, onboarding command log, summary, trace, and resolved recipe.
